text: 天苍苍，野茫茫，风吹草低见牛羊
pinyin: tiān cāng cāng, yě máng máng, fēng chuī cǎo dī xiàn niú yáng
literal: sky · blue · blue, plain · vast · vast, wind · blows · grass · lowers · reveals · cattle · sheep
natural: The sky is blue, the plain vast; when the wind bends the grass, cattle and sheep appear

meaning.en: A famous picture of the endless grasslands under the sky.
meaning.zh: 描写辽阔无边的草原风光，风吹草低处牛羊隐现。

equivalents: the boundless grassland

examples.zh: 驱车来到内蒙古草原，他脱口而出“天苍苍，野茫茫，风吹草低见牛羊”。
examples.en: Driving onto the Inner Mongolian steppe he blurted out this line.

examples.zh: 旅游宣传片用“天苍苍，野茫茫，风吹草低见牛羊”做开场白。
examples.en: The tourism film opened with this line.

story.en: The Chile Song is a Northern Dynasties folk song of the Xianbei-Chile people, said to have been sung by the general Hulü Jin in 546.
story.zh: 《敕勒歌》为北朝民歌，相传东魏名将斛律金曾在546年唱此歌。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 江南可采莲，莲叶何田田。鱼戏莲叶间
pinyin: jiāng nán kě cǎi lián, lián yè hé tián tián, yú xì lián yè jiān
literal: Jiangnan · can · pick · lotus, lotus · leaves · how · lush · lush, fish · play · lotus · leaves · among
natural: In Jiangnan one can pick lotus; how lush the lotus leaves are, and the fish play among them

meaning.en: A lively scene of lotus-picking and fish frolicking in summer in the south.
meaning.zh: 描绘江南夏日采莲、莲叶田田、鱼儿嬉戏的欢快景象。

equivalents: lotus leaves and playful fish

examples.zh: 夏天去荷塘，满池都是“江南可采莲，莲叶何田田。鱼戏莲叶间”。
examples.en: In summer at the lotus pond the whole pool is this line.

examples.zh: 幼儿园的小朋友们学唱“江南可采莲，莲叶何田田。鱼戏莲叶间”。
examples.en: Kindergarten children learn to sing this poem.

story.en: A Han Dynasty folk song from the Yuefu collection, often learnt first by children.
story.zh: 汉乐府民歌《江南》，常为儿童启蒙诵读之作。

date.en: Han dynasty, 2nd c. BC–1st c. AD

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 愿得一心人，白头不相离
pinyin: yuàn dé yī xīn rén, bái tóu bù xiāng lí
literal: wish · get · one · hearted · person, white · head · not · mutually · part
natural: I wish to find a person of one heart, and never part until our hair is white

meaning.en: The ideal of faithful, lifelong love between two people.
meaning.zh: 表达对忠贞专一、白头偕老的爱情的向往。

equivalents: to love one person till old age

examples.zh: 婚礼上，新娘朗读了“愿得一心人，白头不相离”。
examples.en: At the wedding the bride read this line aloud.

examples.zh: 她在日记里写下“愿得一心人，白头不相离”。
examples.en: She wrote this line in her diary.

origin.source: 《白头吟》（汉乐府古辞，传为卓文君作）

story.en: The Han yuefu ballad 'Song of White Hair' has the line 'I wish for one heart, never parted till our hair is white'. Tradition says Zhuo Wenjun wrote it when Sima Xiangru thought of taking a concubine, but the authorship is unproven.
story.zh: 汉乐府《白头吟》有“愿得一心人，白头不相离”之句；相传卓文君因司马相如欲纳妾而作，但作者归属并无确证。

date.en: Han dynasty, 2nd c. BC–2nd c. AD

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 选贤与能，讲信修睦
pinyin: xuǎn xián jǔ néng, jiǎng xìn xiū mù
literal: choose · worthy · and · able, speak · trust · cultivate · harmony
natural: Choose the virtuous and able to lead; value good faith and cultivate harmony

meaning.en: A description of an ideal society that appoints capable leaders and values trust and peace.
meaning.zh: 描述理想社会：选拔贤能之人，讲求诚信，和睦相处。

equivalents: meritocracy and trust

examples.zh: 社区治理要做到“选贤与能，讲信修睦”。
examples.en: Community governance should be a matter of this line.

examples.zh: 政府工作报告里引用了“选贤与能，讲信修睦”。
examples.en: The government work report quoted this line.

story.en: From the 'Great Unity' (大同) passage in the Liyun chapter of the Book of Rites, describing the ideal world in which the Way prevails.
story.zh: 出自《礼记·礼运》“大同”一段，描绘大道通行时的理想社会。

usage.en: A quotation from the classics; formal, used to support an argument or give advice.
usage.zh: 经典引文，书面语，常用来论证或劝勉。

text: 学然后知不足，教然后知困
pinyin: xué rán hòu zhī bù zú, jiào rán hòu zhī kùn
literal: learn · then · know · not · enough, teach · then · know · stuck
natural: Only after studying do you see how little you know; only after teaching do you see where you struggle

meaning.en: Learning shows you your gaps, and teaching shows you your limits; teaching and learning improve each other.
meaning.zh: 学了才知道自己的不足，教了才知道自己的困惑，教学相长。

equivalents: teaching is the best way to learn
the more you learn, the more you realise you don't know

examples.zh: 当了老师才懂得“学然后知不足，教然后知困”。
examples.en: Only after becoming a teacher did I understand this line.

examples.zh: 这句“学然后知不足，教然后知困”让我更用功读书。
examples.en: This line makes me study harder.

story.en: From the Xueji (On Learning) chapter of the Book of Rites, the earliest Chinese treatise on education; the next line says 'so teaching and learning grow together' (教学相长).
story.zh: 出自《礼记·学记》，是中国最早的教育专论，下文为“故曰教学相长也”。

usage.en: A quotation from the classics; formal, used to support an argument or give advice.
usage.zh: 经典引文，书面语，常用来论证或劝勉。

text: 兵者，国之大事，死生之地，存亡之道，不可不察也
pinyin: bīng zhě, guó zhī dà shì, sǐ shēng zhī dì, cún wáng zhī dào, bù kě bù chá yě
literal: war · it, state · of · great · matter, death · life · of · ground, survive · perish · of · way, not · can · not · examine
natural: War is a great matter of state, a place of life and death and the road to survival or ruin; it must be studied carefully

meaning.en: War decides a nation's fate and must be treated with the utmost seriousness.
meaning.zh: 战争关乎国家的生死存亡，必须慎重对待、认真研究。

equivalents: war is too serious to be taken lightly

examples.zh: 军事学院开课第一讲就是“兵者，国之大事，死生之地，存亡之道，不可不察也”。
examples.en: The first lecture at the military academy opens with this line.

examples.zh: “兵者，国之大事，死生之地，存亡之道，不可不察也”提醒决策者不可轻启战端。
examples.en: This line warns decision-makers not to start war lightly.

story.en: The opening of The Art of War by Sun Tzu (Sunzi), setting the tone for the whole book.
story.zh: 《孙子兵法》开篇首句，为全书定下基调。

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前5世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 5th c. BC

usage.en: A quotation from the classics; formal, used to support an argument or give advice.
usage.zh: 经典引文，书面语，常用来论证或劝勉。

text: 兵者，诡道也
pinyin: bīng zhě, guǐ dào yě
literal: war · it, deceptive · way · is
natural: War is the way of deception

meaning.en: Warfare relies on misleading the enemy; also used of tactics and negotiation.
meaning.zh: 用兵打仗要用欺敌迷惑之术；也常用于谈判和竞争中的策略。

equivalents: all is fair in war
war is deception

examples.zh: “兵者，诡道也”，商战中也常常如此。
examples.en: 'War is deception', and business competition is often like that too.

examples.zh: 教练说“兵者，诡道也”，要懂得声东击西。
examples.en: The coach said this, urging us to learn feints.

story.en: From the Jipian (Initial Estimates) chapter of The Art of War, followed by lines such as 'when able, appear unable'.
story.zh: 出自《孙子兵法·计篇》，下文接“能而示之不能”等诡道十二法。

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前5世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 5th c. BC

usage.en: A quotation from the classics; formal, used to support an argument or give advice.
usage.zh: 经典引文，书面语，常用来论证或劝勉。

text: 攻其不备，出其不意
pinyin: gōng qí bù bèi, chū qí bù yì
literal: attack · it · without · preparation, come out · it · not · expect
natural: Attack where he is unprepared and appear where he does not expect you

meaning.en: Strike when the enemy is unready and take them by surprise.
meaning.zh: 趁敌人没有防备时进攻，从对方意想不到的地方出击。

equivalents: catch them off guard
strike when least expected

examples.zh: 球队用“攻其无备，出其不意”的战术赢了比赛。
examples.en: The team won the match with a catch-them-off-guard tactic.

examples.zh: 创业公司想靠“攻其无备，出其不意”挤进市场。
examples.en: The start-up wants to squeeze into the market by taking rivals by surprise.

story.en: From Sunzi's list of the rules of deception: 'attack where he is unprepared, appear where he does not expect you'.
story.zh: 《孙子兵法·计篇》论诡道：“攻其无备，出其不意。”

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前5世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 5th c. BC

usage.en: A quotation from the classics; formal, used to support an argument or give advice.
usage.zh: 经典引文，书面语，常用来论证或劝勉。

text: 其疾如风，其徐如林，侵掠如火，不动如山
pinyin: qí jí rú fēng, qí xú rú lín, qīn lüè rú huǒ, bù dòng rú shān
literal: its · swiftness · like · wind, its · slowness · like · forest, raiding · like · fire, not · moving · like · mountain
natural: Swift as the wind, steady as a forest, fierce as fire, immovable as a mountain

meaning.en: Four ways an army should move: fast, orderly, fierce and unshakable; also used for versatile behaviour.
meaning.zh: 用兵要像风一样迅疾、像森林一样整齐、像火一样猛烈、像山一样稳重。

equivalents: swift as wind, still as a mountain

examples.zh: 武田信玄的军旗就写着“其疾如风，其徐如林，侵掠如火，不动如山”。
examples.en: Takeda Shingen's war banner carried this line.

examples.zh: 这支球队攻守兼备，真是“其疾如风，其徐如林，侵掠如火，不动如山”。
examples.en: This team attacks and defends in equal measure, exactly this line.

story.en: From the Junzheng (Military Combat) chapter, where Sunzi says an army moves by deception and changes according to circumstances.
story.zh: 出自《孙子兵法·军争》，讲军队行动要因时而变，如风林火山。

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前5世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 5th c. BC

usage.en: A quotation from the classics; formal, used to support an argument or give advice.
usage.zh: 经典引文，书面语，常用来论证或劝勉。

text: 不战而屈人之兵，善之善者也
pinyin: bù zhàn ér qū rén zhī bīng, shàn zhī shàn zhě yě
literal: not · fight · yet · subdue · others · of · troops, good · of · good · one · is
natural: To subdue the enemy's army without fighting is the best of the best

meaning.en: The highest skill in a conflict is to win without a fight.
meaning.zh: 不经过交战就让对方屈服，才是最高明的策略。

equivalents: win without fighting
the supreme art of war

examples.zh: 谈判桌上他“不战而屈人之兵，善之善者也”，让对手让步。
examples.en: At the negotiating table he made his rival give way without a fight: this line.

examples.zh: 外交官常引用“不战而屈人之兵，善之善者也”。
examples.en: Diplomats often quote this line.

story.en: From the Mougong (Attack by Stratagem) chapter: a hundred wins in a hundred battles is not the best skill.
story.zh: 出自《孙子兵法·谋攻》：“百战百胜，非善之善者也”，不战而胜才是最高境界。

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前5世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 5th c. BC

usage.en: A quotation from the classics; formal, used to support an argument or give advice.
usage.zh: 经典引文，书面语，常用来论证或劝勉。

text: 法不阿贵，绳不挠曲
pinyin: fǎ bù ē guì, shéng bù náo qū
literal: law · not · flatter · the noble, plumb-line · not · bend · to crooked
natural: The law does not favour the noble, and the plumb-line does not bend to what is crooked

meaning.en: The law must apply equally to everyone and not bend to power.
meaning.zh: 法律不偏袒权贵，如墨线不迁就弯曲，强调法律面前人人平等。

equivalents: equal before the law
no one is above the law

examples.zh: 检察院门口刻着“法不阿贵，绳不挠曲”。
examples.en: This line is carved at the entrance of the procuratorate.

examples.zh: 法治社会要做到“法不阿贵，绳不挠曲”。
examples.en: A society under the rule of law must live by this line.

story.en: From the Legalist philosopher Han Fei, who argues that clear laws should apply equally to everyone, high or low.
story.zh: 法家韩非主张法令明确，上至权贵、下至百姓一律适用。

date.en: end of Warring States, 3rd c. BC

usage.en: A quotation from the classics; formal, used to support an argument or give advice.
usage.zh: 经典引文，书面语，常用来论证或劝勉。

text: 一年之计，莫如树谷；十年之计，莫如树木；终身之计，莫如树人
pinyin: yī nián zhī jì, mò rú shù gǔ, shí nián zhī jì, mò rú shù mù, zhōng shēn zhī jì, mò rú shù rén
literal: one · year · of · plan, nothing · like · plant · grain, ten · years · of · plan, nothing · like · plant · trees, lifetime · of · plan, nothing · like · cultivate · people
natural: For a year's plan, plant grain; for ten years', plant trees; for a lifetime's, cultivate people

meaning.en: Educating people is the most far-sighted investment of all.
meaning.zh: 培养人才是最长远的投资，教育是百年大计。

equivalents: education is the best long-term investment

examples.zh: 校长说：“一年之计，莫如树谷；十年之计，莫如树木；终身之计，莫如树人”，教育是根本。
examples.en: The headmaster said education is fundamental, quoting this line.

examples.zh: 这个基金会的口号就是“一年之计，莫如树谷；十年之计，莫如树木；终身之计，莫如树人”。
examples.en: The foundation's slogan is this line.

story.en: From the Guanzi, attributed to the statesman Guan Zhong of Qi; the source of the famous saying 十年树木，百年树人.
story.zh: 出自《管子·权修》，相传为管仲所作；“十年树木，百年树人”即由此化出。

date.zh: 战国至西汉 · 前4—前1世纪
date.en: Warring States to Western Han, 4th–1st c. BC

usage.en: A quotation from the classics; formal, used to support an argument or give advice.
usage.zh: 经典引文，书面语，常用来论证或劝勉。

text: 仓廪实而知礼节，衣食足而知荣辱
pinyin: cāng lǐn shí ér zhī lǐ jié, yī shí zú ér zhī róng rǔ
literal: granaries · full · then · know · ritual · restraint, clothing · food · enough · then · know · honour · disgrace
natural: When the granaries are full people know courtesy; when they have enough to eat and wear they know honour and shame

meaning.en: People can attend to morals and manners only when their basic needs are met.
meaning.zh: 物质生活满足之后，人们才会讲求礼节、荣辱。

equivalents: morals follow a full belly

examples.zh: 扶贫工作的底层逻辑就是“仓廪实而知礼节，衣食足而知荣辱”。
examples.en: The underlying logic of poverty alleviation is this line.

examples.zh: 经济发展了，文化建设才跟得上，“仓廪实而知礼节，衣食足而知荣辱”。
examples.en: Only when the economy develops can culture keep up: this line.

story.en: From the Mumin chapter of the Guanzi, on how a ruler should govern the people by first ensuring their livelihood.
story.zh: 出自《管子·牧民》，论治国先使民生富足，再行教化。

date.zh: 战国至西汉 · 前4—前1世纪
date.en: Warring States to Western Han, 4th–1st c. BC

usage.en: A quotation from the classics; formal, used to support an argument or give advice.
usage.zh: 经典引文，书面语，常用来论证或劝勉。

text: 士别三日，即更刮目相待
pinyin: shì bié sān rì, jí gèng guā mù xiāng dài
literal: scholar · part · three · days, then · must · rub · eyes · treat
natural: When a man has been away for three days, you must look at him with fresh eyes

meaning.en: People can progress quickly; do not judge by old impressions.
meaning.zh: 人进步很快，不要用老眼光看人。

equivalents: don't judge by old impressions
see someone in a new light

examples.zh: 他转行才一年就成了专家，真是“士别三日，即更刮目相待”。
examples.en: He became an expert within a year of switching careers: this line exactly.

examples.zh: 同学聚会，大家对她“士别三日，即更刮目相待”。
examples.en: At the reunion everyone saw her in a new light.

origin.source: 《三国志·吴书·吕蒙传》裴松之注引《江表传》

story.en: Sun Quan urged the rough general Lü Meng to study. When Lu Su later met him he was amazed, and Lü Meng replied that after three days apart a scholar should be looked at anew. The line is quoted in Pei Songzhi's note from the Jiang Biao Zhuan.
story.zh: 孙权劝吕蒙读书，后来鲁肃见其长进而惊叹，吕蒙答曰“士别三日，即更刮目相待”；此语见裴松之注引《江表传》。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 臣本布衣，躬耕于南阳，苟全性命于乱世，不求闻达于诸侯
pinyin: chén běn bù yī, gōng gēng yú nán yáng, gǒu quán xìng mìng yú luàn shì, bù qiú wén dá yú zhū hóu
literal: I · originally · commoner, plough · myself · in · Nanyang, scrape · preserve · life · in · chaotic · age, not · seek · fame · reach · among · lords
natural: I was a commoner who farmed in Nanyang, only trying to survive in a time of chaos and not seeking fame among the lords

meaning.en: A statement of modest origins and no ambition for fame.
meaning.zh: 自述出身平民，躬耕隐居，只求在乱世保全性命，不求显达。

equivalents: a humble farmer with no thirst for fame

examples.zh: 他回忆起自己的创业之路，用“臣本布衣，躬耕于南阳，苟全性命于乱世，不求闻达于诸侯”来自谦。
examples.en: Recalling his entrepreneurial path, he modestly used this line.

examples.zh: 这句“臣本布衣，躬耕于南阳，苟全性命于乱世，不求闻达于诸侯”是诸葛亮的自白。
examples.en: This line is Zhuge Liang's own account.

story.en: In the Memorial on Leading the Army (227), Zhuge Liang recalls how Liu Bei visited his thatched hut three times and drew him from retirement.
story.zh: 诸葛亮于227年出师北伐前上《出师表》，追述刘备三顾茅庐、请他出山之事。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 受任于败军之际，奉命于危难之间
pinyin: shòu rèn yú bài jūn zhī jì, fèng mìng yú wēi nàn zhī jiān
literal: receive · duty · in · defeated · army · of · moment, accept · order · in · danger · peril · of · between
natural: I took up my post as the army was defeated and accepted my orders in the midst of danger and difficulty

meaning.en: Taking responsibility at a critical, difficult moment.
meaning.zh: 在局势最危急、困难的时候接受重任。

equivalents: take charge in a crisis

examples.zh: 新任厂长“受任于败军之际，奉命于危难之间”，带领工厂扭亏为盈。
examples.en: The new plant manager took charge in a crisis and turned the factory around.

examples.zh: 她引用“受任于败军之际，奉命于危难之间”来形容自己的任职经历。
examples.en: She quoted this line to describe her experience in the post.

story.en: Zhuge Liang recalls the dark days after the defeat at Changban, when Liu Bei sent him as envoy to Sun Quan.
story.zh: 诸葛亮回忆长坂坡兵败之后，刘备命他出使东吴的危难时刻。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
usage.zh: 引用的名句，书面语，常见于作文、文案、演讲和日常引用。

text: 夫君子之行，静以修身，俭以养德
pinyin: fū jūn zǐ zhī xíng, jìng yǐ xiū shēn, jiǎn yǐ yǎng dé
literal: now · gentleman · of · conduct, stillness · to · cultivate · self, frugality · to · nourish · virtue
natural: A gentleman's conduct is to cultivate himself through stillness and nurture virtue through frugality

meaning.en: Self-cultivation comes from calm and frugality.
meaning.zh: 君子修身养德靠的是内心宁静和俭朴节约。

equivalents: calm and thrift build character

examples.zh: 父亲把“夫君子之行，静以修身，俭以养德”写成条幅挂在书房。
examples.en: My father hung this line as a scroll in his study.

examples.zh: 家风教育强调“夫君子之行，静以修身，俭以养德”。
examples.en: Family-values education stresses this line.

story.en: Zhuge Liang's letter of advice to his young son Zhuge Zhan, urging him to cultivate himself with stillness and thrift.
story.zh: 诸葛亮写给八岁儿子诸葛瞻的家书，劝他以静与俭修身立志。

text: 外无期功强近之亲，内无应门五尺之僮，茕茕孑立，形影相吊
pinyin: wài wú jī gōng qiáng jìn zhī qīn, nèi wú yìng mén wǔ chǐ zhī tóng, qióng qióng jié lì, xíng yǐng xiāng diào
literal: outside · no · distant · kin · of · near · relatives, inside · no · door-answering · five · foot · of · servant, lonely · lonely · alone · stand, body · shadow · mutually · console
natural: Outside there are no close relatives, inside no servant boy of five feet to answer the door; I stand alone and lonely, with only my shadow for company

meaning.en: Describes extreme loneliness and having no relatives to rely on.
meaning.zh: 形容孤苦无依、没有亲人可依靠的境况。

equivalents: utterly alone with no one to turn to

examples.zh: 独居老人的处境，真是“外无期功强近之亲，内无应门五尺之僮，茕茕孑立，形影相吊”。
examples.en: The condition of the elderly living alone is exactly this line.

examples.zh: 李密用“外无期功强近之亲，内无应门五尺之僮，茕茕孑立，形影相吊”描写自己的孤苦。
examples.en: Li Mi used this line to describe his loneliness.

story.en: Li Mi (Western Jin) wrote the memorial asking Emperor Wu to excuse him from office so that he could care for his aged grandmother who had raised him.
story.zh: 西晋李密上表晋武帝，请求辞官以奉养祖母，自述孤苦。

text: 一日不见，如隔三秋
pinyin: yī rì bù jiàn, rú gé sān qiū
literal: one · day · not · see, like · separated · three · autumns
natural: One day without seeing you feels like three years

meaning.en: Longing so strong that a short separation feels very long.
meaning.zh: 思念情切，短暂分别也觉得时间很漫长。

equivalents: a day apart feels like an age

examples.zh: 异地恋的他们，每天都觉得“一日不见，如隔三秋”。
examples.en: The long-distance couple feel every day that this line is true.

examples.zh: 好友出国后，她写道：“一日不见，如隔三秋”。
examples.en: After her friend went abroad she wrote this line.

story.en: From the Book of Songs, 'Picking Pueraria': a lover says 'one day without seeing you is like three months, like three autumns, like three years'.
story.zh: 《诗经·王风·采葛》：“彼采葛兮，一日不见，如三月兮。”后世演变为“如隔三秋”。

date.zh: 西周初至春秋中叶 · 前11—前6世纪
date.en: early Western Zhou to mid Spring and Autumn, 11th–6th c. BC

text: 不孝有三，无后为大
pinyin: bù xiào yǒu sān, wú hòu wéi dà
literal: unfilial · have · three, no · heir · is · greatest
natural: There are three kinds of unfilial conduct, and having no heir is the worst

meaning.en: A traditional belief that failing to continue the family line is the gravest failure of filial duty; today often quoted critically.
meaning.zh: 传统观念认为没有后代是最大的不孝；今天多被批评性引用。

equivalents: the old idea that failing to carry on the family line is the greatest unfilial act

examples.zh: 老一辈人总说“不孝有三，无后为大”，年轻人未必认同。
examples.en: The older generation keeps saying this, but young people may not agree.

examples.zh: 这句“不孝有三，无后为大”在今天常被视为陈旧观念。
examples.en: This line is now often seen as an outdated idea.

story.en: Mencius says there are three unfilial acts and having no heir is the worst; the Han commentator Zhao Qi lists them, and the line has been much quoted and criticised.
story.zh: 出自《孟子·离娄上》；东汉赵岐注列出“三不孝”，此语后世流传甚广，亦屡受批评。

usage.en: A quotation from the classics; formal, used to support an argument or give advice.

text: 不患寡而患不均
pinyin: bù huàn guǎ ér huàn bù jūn
literal: not · worry · scarcity · but · worry · not · equal
natural: Do not worry about having little, but about unequal distribution

meaning.en: Unfair distribution upsets people more than scarcity itself.
meaning.zh: 不担心财富少，而担心分配不公。

equivalents: it's not poverty but inequality that breeds discontent

examples.zh: 公司奖金分配不均，员工怨声载道：“不患寡而患不均”。
examples.en: The company's unequal bonuses caused grumbling: this line exactly.

examples.zh: 社会学者常引用“不患寡而患不均”讨论收入差距。
examples.en: Sociologists often quote this line when discussing income gaps.

story.en: Confucius, criticising the Ji family's plan to attack the small state of Zhuanyu, said: 'do not worry about scarcity but about unequal distribution, nor about poverty but about instability.'
story.zh: 孔子论季氏将伐颛臾时所言：“不患寡而患不均，不患贫而患不安。”

usage.en: A quotation from the classics; formal, used to support an argument or give advice.

text: 人之将死，其言也善
pinyin: rén zhī jiāng sǐ, qí yán yě shàn
literal: person · of · about to · die, his · words · also · good
natural: When a person is about to die, his words are good

meaning.en: A dying person's words are usually sincere and kind.
meaning.zh: 人临终前的话往往真诚善良。

equivalents: a dying man's words are true

examples.zh: 老人弥留之际，把家产分给了亲戚，所谓“人之将死，其言也善”。
examples.en: On his deathbed the old man shared out his estate: this line proves true.

examples.zh: 法庭上，证人引用“人之将死，其言也善”来证明遗言的可信。
examples.en: In court the witness quoted this line to show the dying statement is credible.

story.en: Said by Zeng Zi (a disciple of Confucius) to the high official Meng Jingzi when he was ill: 'when a bird is about to die, its call is sad; when a man is about to die, his words are good.'
story.zh: 曾子在孟敬子探病时所言：“鸟之将死，其鸣也哀；人之将死，其言也善。”

usage.en: A quotation from the classics; formal, used to support an argument or give advice.
usage.zh: 经典引文，书面语，常用来论证或劝勉。

text: 人非生而知之者，孰能无惑
pinyin: rén fēi shēng ér zhī zhī zhě, shú néng wú huò
literal: people · not · born · and · know · it · ones, who · can · without · doubt
natural: No one is born knowing; who can be without doubts?

meaning.en: Everyone needs to learn, and everyone has questions; hence the need for teachers.
meaning.zh: 没有人生来就懂，谁能没有疑惑呢？所以需要老师。

equivalents: no one is born knowing everything

examples.zh: 他总怕被人笑话，不肯问问题，其实“人非生而知之者，孰能无惑”。
examples.en: He is afraid of being laughed at and won't ask questions, but this line says everyone has doubts.

examples.zh: 语文老师在讲《师说》时引用了“人非生而知之者，孰能无惑”。
examples.en: The teacher quoted this line when covering 'On Teachers'.

story.en: In 'On Teachers' (Shi Shuo), Han Yu argues that anyone who knows the Way can be a teacher, regardless of age or status.
story.zh: 韩愈《师说》主张“道之所存，师之所存”，不论年龄与地位。

usage.en: A quoted line; literary, common in essays, captions, speeches and everyday quotation.
